b01c01-sell-old-account-s05.english: His younger sister does not say anything.

b01c01-sell-old-account-s05.chinese: 可是李贤看得出来，她每天都在担心家里的钱。
b01c01-sell-old-account-s05.english: But Lee Hyun can tell that she worries about the family's money every day.

b01c01-sell-old-account-s10.chinese: 以前他最难过的时候，他常常打开电脑。
b01c01-sell-old-account-s10.english: When he felt the saddest before, he often opened the computer.

b01c01-sell-old-account-s10.chinese: 看着那个账号，他心里会安静一点。
b01c01-sell-old-account-s10.english: Looking at that account made him feel a little calmer.

b01c01-sell-old-account-s20.chinese: 他坐了很久，才慢慢明白自己一直舍不得的不是游戏本身。
b01c01-sell-old-account-s20.english: He sits for a long time and slowly understands that what he cannot let go of is not the game itself.

b01c01-sell-old-account-s20.chinese: 而是那个“我还没有输”的感觉。
b01c01-sell-old-account-s20.english: It is the feeling that he has not lost yet.

b01c01-sell-old-account-s26.chinese: 他知道，真正让人安心的，不是手里留着什么东西。
b01c01-sell-old-account-s26.english: He knows that true peace does not come from holding on to something.

b01c01-sell-old-account-s26.chinese: 而是自己愿意为了家里去做对的事。
b01c01-sell-old-account-s26.english: It comes from being willing to do the right thing for his family.

b01c02-hit-the-scarecrow-s01.chinese: 杂草进入皇家之路以后，没有先去找热闹的地方。
b01c02-hit-the-scarecrow-s01.english: After Weed enters Royal Road, he does not look for a lively place first.

b01c02-hit-the-scarecrow-s01.chinese: 他也没有急着去做简单任务。
b01c02-hit-the-scarecrow-s01.english: He does not hurry to do easy quests either.

b01c02-hit-the-scarecrow-s09.chinese: 他一直有一个想法：自己开始得太晚。
b01c02-hit-the-scarecrow-s09.english: He keeps thinking that he started too late.

b01c02-hit-the-scarecrow-s09.chinese: 钱也不多，运气也不会特别好。
b01c02-hit-the-scarecrow-s09.english: He does not have much money, and his luck will not be especially good.

b01c02-hit-the-scarecrow-s20.chinese: 只在杂草快没有力气的时候，教官问了一句。
b01c02-hit-the-scarecrow-s20.english: Only when Weed is nearly out of strength does the instructor ask a question.
Are you training, or are you only being angry?

b01c02-hit-the-scarecrow-s29.chinese: 那一刻，杂草才知道，吃苦不一定会让人变强。
b01c02-hit-the-scarecrow-s29.english: At that moment, Weed learns that hardship alone will not necessarily make a person strong.
A person must also be willing to change.

b01c03-listen-to-the-story-s01.chinese: 杂草为了一个关于月光的任务，先去找雕刻店的店主。
b01c03-listen-to-the-story-s01.english: For a quest about moonlight, Weed first goes to the sculpture shop keeper.

b01c03-listen-to-the-story-s01.chinese: 他又去酒馆找吟游诗人，后来还去找旧女仆。
b01c03-listen-to-the-story-s01.english: He then goes to the tavern bard and later to the old maid.

b01c03-listen-to-the-story-s12.chinese: 他心里一直觉得，东西要马上有用。
b01c03-listen-to-the-story-s12.english: He keeps thinking that things must be useful right away.

b01c03-listen-to-the-story-s12.chinese: 这样的东西才值得花时间。
b01c03-listen-to-the-story-s12.english: Only those things are worth spending time on.

b01c03-listen-to-the-story-s14.chinese: 他真的站起来，准备离开。
b01c03-listen-to-the-story-s14.english: He truly stands up and prepares to leave.

b01c03-listen-to-the-story-s14.chinese: 但这时，他忽然想到自己在训练场的日子。
b01c03-listen-to-the-story-s14.english: But then he suddenly thinks about his days in the training hall.

b01c03-listen-to-the-story-s18.chinese: 这一次，他不再只想“快点结束”。
b01c03-listen-to-the-story-s18.english: This time, he no longer only wants it to end quickly.

b01c03-listen-to-the-story-s18.chinese: 他开始认真听，认真问，也认真把每个人的话放在一起想。
b01c03-listen-to-the-story-s18.english: He starts to listen carefully, ask carefully, and think about everyone's words together.

b01c03-listen-to-the-story-s21.chinese: 他想起那份约定、那个夜晚，还有那把像剑一样的雕刻刀。
b01c03-listen-to-the-story-s21.english: He remembers the promise, the night, and the sword-like sculpting knife.
It turns out that all of them are connected.

b01c03-last-old-sentence-s18.chinese: 他正准备第二次站起来。
b01c03-last-old-sentence-s18.english: He is preparing to stand up for the second time.

b01c03-last-old-sentence-s18.chinese: 可就在这时，旧女仆忽然提到了一把刀。
b01c03-last-old-sentence-s18.english: But just then, the old maid suddenly mentions a knife.

b01c04-useless-looking-job-s20.chinese: 每个人都觉得这个职业没用。
b01c04-useless-looking-job-s20.english: Everyone thinks this class is useless.

b01c04-useless-looking-job-s20.chinese: 也许只是因为他们只看今天。
b01c04-useless-looking-job-s20.english: Maybe it is only because they are looking at today.

b01c06-unsold-carving-s34.chinese: 可是回去的时候，他第一次不是只想“怎么卖”。
b01c06-unsold-carving-s34.english: But on the way back, for the first time he is not only thinking, 'How do I sell this?'

b01c06-unsold-carving-s34.chinese: 他开始想：“我到底做了什么？”
b01c06-unsold-carving-s34.english: He starts thinking, 'What did I actually make?'

b01c09-one-look-customer-s14.chinese: 他忽然想到，自己如果现在回过去，会有什么结果。
b01c09-one-look-customer-s14.english: He suddenly thinks about what will happen if he fires back now.
The whole day will be ruined.

b01c10-asked-the-name-s29.chinese: 那一天以后，杂草第一次认真想。
b01c10-asked-the-name-s29.english: After that day, Weed seriously considers something for the first time.

b01c10-asked-the-name-s29.chinese: 自己的名字也许会慢慢传开。
b01c10-asked-the-name-s29.english: His name may slowly begin to spread.
